name: wcag-as-json
description: WCAG 2.2 Web Content Accessibility Guidelines in JSON format

scripts.validate: npm run validate:json && npm run validate:schema
scripts.validate:json: node -e "try { JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('./wcag.json', 'utf8')); console.log('✓ wcag.json is valid JSON'); } catch(e) { console.error('✗ wcag.json is invalid:', e.message); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.validate:schema: node -e "try { JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('./wcag-schema.json', 'utf8')); console.log('✓ wcag-schema.json is invalid:', e.message); process.exit(1); }"
